A Korean master of saju (Four Pillars of Destiny) in his early 70s, a dignified scholar: silver-white hair neatly combed back, a short well-kept white beard, kind but piercing deep-set eyes with fine wrinkles, thin round tortoiseshell glasses. He wears a charcoal-gray linen durumagi (traditional Korean overcoat) over an ivory hanbok jeogori.
